questions.question: In the six-stage pipeline, what happens at Stage 4 (Animate) and which tool is typically used?
options: The mesh is uploaded to Mixamo for auto-rigging and motion-capture animation
Textures are generated with AI tools like Leonardo.ai
The model is compressed with gltf-transform and Draco
The model is loaded into R3F and rendered in the browser
questions.explanation: Stage 4 is animation. Mixamo handles auto-rigging and provides over 2,000 free motion-capture animations. You upload your cleaned mesh and get back an animated FBX in minutes.

questions.question: A developer is building a 3D product page with no coding team and a 1-week deadline. Which tool choice is most appropriate?
options: React Three Fiber with custom GLSL shaders
Three.js with a full physics engine
Spline for a no-code embed or model-viewer web component
Blender with a custom Python export script
questions.explanation: Spline's no-code editor and embed feature (or Google's model-viewer web component) are ideal when speed and simplicity matter more than custom code.

questions.question: In the portfolio case study, approximately how long does the full AI-assisted pipeline take from prompt to deployed website?
options: About 30 minutes
About 2 hours
About 1 week
About 8 hours
questions.explanation: The case study estimates approximately 2 hours total: 15 min for Meshy, 20 min for Blender, 10 min for Mixamo, 5 min for optimization, 45 min for R3F code, and 5 min for Vercel deployment.

questions.question: Which scenario is the best fit for using vanilla Three.js instead of React Three Fiber?
options: Building a 3D product page inside an existing React application
Sharing 3D components across multiple React applications
Using Suspense and concurrent rendering features
Adding a 3D scene to a vanilla HTML/CSS/JS portfolio with no build step
questions.explanation: Three.js is better for non-React projects. R3F requires a React app setup. For a vanilla HTML/JS portfolio, Three.js with a CDN import or simple npm setup is simpler and faster.

questions.question: What does 'AI as accelerator, not replacement' mean in the context of this workflow?
options: AI generates all assets automatically with no human input needed
AI compresses the tedious parts (mesh generation, rigging) while humans provide judgment, taste, and code
AI replaces the need to learn Three.js or Blender
AI handles mesh generation and textures so you can focus on writing more AI prompts
questions.explanation: AI tools compress the time-consuming parts, but human judgment is essential for deciding what to build, adjusting what AI gets wrong, writing the rendering code, and ensuring the final result looks good.
